about: A check by eye of the measured scores (scores.json). The coding agent (Claude, a closed model) looked at every one of the 106 measured images beside its characters' sheets on 2026-10-23. DRAFT for the owner: the owner's own look decides.
picking: Redos are picked from this by-eye list only, never from the automatic scores (owner, 2026-10-23: "The automatic scores were wrong 6 times in 10, so don't use them to pick redos: use the by-eye list, and I'll judge the trial by eye.").
finding: The commonest fault is a double: a character's costume (or hair) copied onto a second person in the same picture. The automatic scores catch that only sometimes (the 'possible double' flag); they mostly measure the figure taken to be the character, and that step fails when a character is small, seated or seen from behind.
